description_en: Calls DescribeCurrentNodeInfo to retrieve the process information of the current node
description_zh: 调用DescribeCurrentNodeInfo获取当前节点的流程信息
name: DescribeCurrentNodeInfo

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Marketplace order
parameters.name: instance_id

Result.description_en: The process node information returned upon success

AllowRollbackNode.description_en: Indicates whether rollback to the previous process node is allowed
AllowRollbackNode.description_zh: 是否允许执行回滚到上一个流程节点

AutoFinishNode.description_en: Indicates whether the node is automatically completed

FinalStepNo.description_en: The sequence number of the last node

GmtExpired.description_en: The timeout of the process node. The value is a UNIX timestamp
GmtExpired.description_zh: 流程节点超时时间（unix时间戳）

GmtFinished.description_en: The completion time of the process node. The value is a UNIX timestamp
GmtFinished.description_zh: 流程节点完成时间（unix时间戳）

GmtStart.description_en: The start time of the process node. The value is a UNIX timestamp
GmtStart.description_zh: 流程节点开始时间（unix时间戳）

NeedAttachment.description_en: Indicates whether uploading an attachment is mandatory
NeedAttachment.description_zh: 是否强制要求上传附件

NextNodeId.description_en: The ID of the next process node

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the process node

NodeStatus.description_en:
The execution status of the node. Valid values:
NotStart: not started.
Starting: in progress.
Cancel: canceled.
Finish: completed
NodeStatus.description_zh: 节点执行状态，取值：-NotStart：未开始-Starting：进行中-Cancel：已取消-Finish：已完成

OperatorRole.description_en:
The role of the operator for the process node. Valid values:
system: system.
custom: user
OperatorRole.description_zh: 流程节点操作人角色，取值：-system：系统-custom：用户

ParentNodeId.description_en: The ID of the parent process node

PreviousNodeId.description_en: The ID of the previous process node

StepNo.description_en: The sequence number of the process node

TemplateForm.description_en:
The form content of the process node in JSON format.
Sample code:
`[ { "fieldKey": "TFD0", //form key "isRequired": true, //whether the field is required "maxLength": 50, //maximum length "placeHolder": "姓名", //form value description "stepNum": 0, //sort value (ascending) "title": "收货人姓名", //form title "type": "text" //form type }, { "fieldKey": "TFD1", "isRequired": true, "maxLength": 50, "placeHolder": "手机号码", "stepNum": 1, "title": "收货人电话", "type": "text" }, { "fieldKey": "TFD2", "isRequired": true, "maxLength": 50, "placeHolder": "省市区街道门牌号码", "stepNum": 2, "title": "详细收货地址", "type": "textarea" } ]`
TemplateForm.description_zh:
流程节点表单内容，格式为json。
示例代码如下：
`[ { "fieldKey": "TFD0", //表单 key "isRequired": true, //是否必填项 "maxLength": 50, //最大值长度 "placeHolder": "姓名", //表单值简介 "stepNum": 0, //排序值（升序） "title": "收货人姓名", //表单标题 "type": "text" //表单类型 }, { "fieldKey": "TFD1", "isRequired": true, "maxLength": 50, "placeHolder": "手机号码", "stepNum": 1, "title": "收货人电话", "type": "text" }, { "fieldKey": "TFD2", "isRequired": true, "maxLength": 50, "placeHolder": "省市区街道门牌号码", "stepNum": 2, "title": "详细收货地址", "type": "textarea" } ]`
TemplateForm.example: [ {"fieldKey": "TFD0","isRequired": true,"maxLength": 50, "placeHolder": "姓名","stepNum": 0,"title": "收货人姓名","type": "text" },{ "fieldKey": "TFD1","isRequired": true,"maxLength": 50,"placeHolder": "手机号码","stepNum": 1,"title": "收货人电话","type": "text"},{"fieldKey": "TFD2","isRequired": true,"maxLength": 50,"placeHolder": "省市区街道门牌号码","stepNum": 2,"title": "详细收货地址","type": "textarea"}]

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
